actions: OPEN INPUT CONTROL-FILE HOLD-FILE OUTPUT TRAN-OUT REPORT-OUT
MOVE 'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is not `ALL '0'`, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `HOLD-FILE` for input and `TRAN-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; displays `'HOLDEXT: CANNOT OPEN FILES '` `WS-FILE-STATUSES`; sets `RETURN-CODE` to 16; and stops the run.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds no more records, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `HOLD-FILE` for input and `TRAN-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'NO BANK CONTROL RECORD'`; and performs `9900-ABORT`.

When `WS-FILE-STATUSES` is `ALL '0'` and reading `CONTROL-FILE` finds a record, it opens `CONTROL-FILE` and `HOLD-FILE` for input and `TRAN-OUT` and `REPORT-OUT` for output; reads `CONTROL-FILE`; sets `TRAN-RECORD` to spaces; sets `TR-REC-TYPE` to `TR-HEADER`; sets `TH-BUSINESS-DATE` to `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`; sets `TH-SOURCE` to `TH-FROM-CARDS`; sets `TH-FILE-SEQ` to 1; writes `TRAN-OUT-RECORD` from `TRAN-RECORD`; and performs `1200-READ-HOLD`.
When reading `HOLD-FILE` finds no more records, it reads `HOLD-FILE` and sets `WS-HOLDS-END-SW` to `END-OF-HOLDS`.
When reading `HOLD-FILE` finds a record, it reads `HOLD-FILE` and adds 1 to `WS-HOLD-COUNT`.

actions: MOVE 'A HOLD OF ANOTHER BUSINESS DAY' TO WS-ABORT-MESSAGE

rules.sentence: When `HD-BUSINESS-DATE` is not `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`, it sets `WS-ABORT-MESSAGE` to `'A HOLD OF ANOTHER BUSINESS DAY'` and performs `9900-ABORT`.
When `HD-BUSINESS-DATE` is `BC-BUSINESS-DATE` and `HD-STATUS` is `'R'` (`HD-REVERSED`), it adds 1 to `WS-REVERSED-COUNT` and performs `1200-READ-HOLD`.

When `HD-BUSINESS-DATE` is `BC-BUSINESS-DATE`, `HD-STATUS` is not `'R'` (not `HD-REVERSED`), `HD-KIND` is `'P'` (`HD-PURCHASE`), and `HD-FEE` is more than 0, it sets `TRAN-RECORD` to spaces, sets `TR-REC-TYPE` to `TR-DETAIL`, sets `WS-TI-HOLD-NO` to `HD-HOLD-NO`, sets `TD-ACCT-NO` to `HD-ACCT-NO`, sets `TD-DESCRIPTION` to `HD-TERMINAL`, sets `TD-COUNTER-ACCT-NO` to 0, sets `TD-TRAN-CODE` to `TD-CARD-PURCHASE`, sets `TD-AMOUNT` to `HD-AMOUNT`, sets `WS-TI-PART` to 1, performs `2900-WRITE-DETAIL`, sets `TD-TRAN-CODE` to `TD-ATM-FEE`, sets `TD-AMOUNT` to `HD-FEE`, sets `TD-DESCRIPTION` to `'ATM FEE'`, sets `WS-TI-PART` to 2, performs `2900-WRITE-DETAIL`, and performs `1200-READ-HOLD`.
